semantic.justification: Original LibreOffice Calendar_hijri temporal mapping and Meeus new-moon calculation. This is the source's Gregorian-backed service, distinct from ICU Islamic calendars. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced. Unchanged extracted LibreOffice temporal method bodies linked against unchanged ICU78.3 match2226 field/era/offset/validation cases across seven temporal providers and six zones. Minimal UNO declarations and integral-millisecond RTL round binding isolate this witness; full UNO service registration/display/fractional rounding are not claimed.
